final_message:
The bug has been fixed. The issue was that `slugify()` didn't properly handle consecutive special characters and multiple spaces - it replaced each non-alphanumeric character with a hyphen individually, resulting in multiple consecutive hyphens instead of collapsing them into a single one.

The fix adds two steps:
1. Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens
2. Collapse consecutive hyphens into a single one using `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`
3. Strip leading and trailing hyphens to clean up edge cases
